data.title: 厄普西隆 · 名流沙龙的微醺执盏
data.description: 四越顶级宴会厅的二楼贵宾回廊上。厄普西隆侧身轻倚雕花漆木栏杆，指尖优雅轻摇高脚杯中深红酒液，居高临下俯瞰宴会厅里受四越商会摆布的王都权贵，眼神深邃而冷艳。
data.location: luxurious mezzanine VIP balcony adorned with carved balustrades and gilded chandeliers
data.action: leaning against a gilded handrail, swirling a crystal glass of red wine, gazing down with a poised, aristocratic enigmatic smile
data.lighting: soft chandelier glow casting amber sparkles on silk fabric and gold embroidery
data.mood: aristocratic allure, manipulative intelligence, supreme high-society composure
data.promptProse: Epsilon in a peacock cheongsam leans on a grand salon balcony at night, swirling red wine while gazing down with cold aristocratic poise.
data.animaCaption: Epsilon observing the grand ballroom from a mezzanine balcony with a glass of red wine.
